annotations.title: Is this EU article still good law

description: STILL-GOOD-LAW CHECK for EU law — the EU twin of check_status. Answers at BOTH levels, because either alone misleads: whether the ACT is in force, expired or repealed (and by what), and whether the ARTICLE's own text has been rewritten and when. An act can be repealed while the article's text sits unchanged in the corpus, and an article can have been rewritten while the act is perfectly in force. Short and cheap on purpose: run it before citing an EU provision. It also warns when the consolidated series stops before today, so coverage is never mistaken for currency, and when a future version of the act already exists.
name: eu_check_status
